name: Cadence
desc: Patient Activation Specialist | $23.00 - $24.00/hr + incentives ($60K - $70K OTE) | High Volume Phone, Technical Support and Patient Coordination
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Required Experience: 2+ years in a customer service, technical support, or patient-facing coordination role, preferably in healthcare or a regulated industry.
 Preferred Experience:
Healthcare or clinical environment background
Experience communicating technical information to non-technical audiences
 Required Skills:
Clear phone communication with non-technical patients, specifically older adults
Proficiency with Mac products and standard call handling and documentation tools
Comfort using AI productivity tools such as Gemini, Notion AI, or comparable platforms
Ability to manage a structured, high-volume daily caseload
Strong written documentation skills for accurate activation records
 Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with 2+ years of customer service, technical support, or patient coordination experience who is genuinely patient and warm with older adults
Participants who are comfortable troubleshooting basic technology issues over the phone and explaining steps clearly to someone who may be unfamiliar with devices
People who want a Monday through Friday schedule with no weekends and a strong OTE compensation structure
Anyone interested in remote patient monitoring and chronic disease management as a growing healthcare career lane
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants without at least 2 years of relevant customer service or patient-facing experience
Anyone who is not comfortable with or not open to using AI productivity tools as part of their daily workflow, since this is listed as a required skill
Participants who struggle with patience or clear communication when working with elderly or less tech-savvy callers
 Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Patient activation
Remote patient monitoring
Device setup and troubleshooting
Healthcare customer service
Technical support
Medicare patient communication
Chronic disease management
Clinical coordination
AI productivity tools
High-volume patient calls
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:

Apply directly through Cadence's official careers page at cadence.care/our-team. Cadence's talent team only directs candidates through this official site and will never request payment or conduct interviews through messaging apps. Expect a recruiter phone screen followed by additional interview rounds with the hiring team.
Likely interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you walked someone through a technical process over the phone who had no prior experience with the technology.
How do you adjust your communication style when speaking with an older adult who is confused or frustrated?
Describe your experience managing a high volume of calls while maintaining accuracy in your documentation.
What AI productivity tools have you used in a previous role and how did you apply them to your daily work?
other:
A home office stipend is included in benefits. Posting notes proficiency with Mac products is required, confirm whether equipment is provided or if participants need their own Mac-compatible setup during the recruiter screen.
Shift: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern, Central, or Mountain Time.
